data.summary: All figures match Apple's reported FY2024 and FY2023 results. Revenue was $391.0B vs $383.3B (+2.0%), net income $93.7B vs $97.0B (−3.4%), operating cash flow $118.3B vs $110.5B, total assets $365.0B vs $352.6B, total liabilities $308.0B vs $290.4B, and cash $29.9B vs $30.0B. The conclusions follow from these numbers. The analysis leaves out the roughly $10.2B one-time EU state aid tax charge, which explains the drop in net income.
